candidate_description: Current matched-BIE pressure integral plus current end term.

Treats the first aft active station as a free-surface start-up station: it remains in the solved station history, but its pressure-density contribution is excluded from whole-ship integration; the current end term is retained.
Same aft start-up pressure exclusion, but without adding the current end term. This separates pressure-integral sensitivity from end-contour sensitivity.
Keeps the full time-derivative pressure integral and current end term, but excludes the first aft active station only from the forward-speed pressure-gradient integral.
Keeps the full forward-speed pressure-gradient integral and current end term, but excludes the first aft active station only from the time-derivative pressure integral.
Control candidate excluding the bow active station pressure integral while retaining the current end term; this checks whether endpoint sensitivity is aft-specific.
Control candidate excluding both aft and bow active station pressure integrals while retaining the current end term.
